stations.title: Your HTML
stations.gap: Data with no rows or columns

captions: Kofi keeps getting calls from people who want to know when the Saturday class is.
The timetable is on the page, but as lines of commas that nobody reads.
You build a table with rows, cells, headers for both directions and a caption.
Visitors read across the handbuilding row and find the day, the time and the price.
Same words from Kofi. Now his timetable is a real table.
